window_condition.scope: Physical center hit-test and window state, not physical scanout. Owned QA topmost/cover windows only; no global Windows settings.
window_condition.selection_scope: Every detected condition violation and first/last samples retained; full generated raw trace remains local. Scores and failed attempts are never excluded.

runtime_trace.thread_core_assignment: Per-core load and per-thread CPU time; scheduler migration/core placement requires ETW, not inferred.

conditions.thermal_throttling: not observable with available public sensors

scope: Diagnostic only. GC after stop; full detach measures observer retention. Summed RSS may duplicate UMA pages. No physical sync/FPS qualification.
